note: Collision petition (Law 39): 'cepstrum' is proposed for 'cepstrum' (the quefrency-domain representation of a signal's spectral structure) against existing holder 'cepstrum'. Claimed distinction: The cepstrum operates in quefrency (time-like) domain, not frequency domain. Existing entries like spectral-analysis (if it exists) or spectral-flattening operate in the frequency domain or manipulate spectral magnitudes directly. The cepstrum's distinct output — peaks at quefrencies corresponding to spectral periodicity — cannot be obtained from any existing entry without performing the full transform sequence. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'lexeme' is proposed for 'lexeme' (Lexeme as the abstract lexical unit in the mental lexicon, distinct from surface word forms.) against existing holder 'lexeme'. Claimed distinction: Distinguished from word (a surface form with phonological realization and syntactic behavior) by being abstract and identity-invariant across inflectional variants. Distinguished from morpheme (the minimal meaningful unit that can be further divided phonologically) by carrying semantic identity that unifies all its surface realizations. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'filterbank' is proposed for 'filterbank' (A bank of bandpass filters arranged to decompose an input signal into multiple frequency sub-bands, with each filter passing a distinct frequency range.) against existing holder 'filter-bank'. Claimed distinction: The existing filter entry covers the generic mechanical device for separating particles by size. A signal processing filterbank decomposes a continuous or digital signal into frequency sub-bands via mathematical transforms — it operates on signals, not matter, and uses interrelated bandpass filters rather than a single separation element. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

CONTAINS is part-whole (Law 10). Pinned sense: neurolinguistics as a research area within the discipline — its accepted definition carves it as a field of the study of neural and biological mechanisms underlying language, one of the areas in which the discipline operates. It complements the accepted neurolinguistics INSTANCE_OF linguistics (nearest kind) exactly as the accepted pairs do for every other subfield: morphology, pragmatics, phonology, phonetics, syntax, semantics, lexicography, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics are each both INSTANCE_OF linguistics and CONTAINED by it. A subfield is a part of the discipline and a member of its kind; both edges stand, as the court has accepted eleven times.

The accepted definition names the quantity as an operational input: stage (2) computes the power spectrum via FFT and stage (3) passes that spectrum through the triangular Mel-scale filterbank. Remove the power spectrum and the filterbank stage has no band energies to take the logarithm of — the pipeline cannot operate as defined. A produced intermediate the defined operation acts on, not a revealed property. Same accepted shape as the sibling quantity edge mfcc DEPENDS_ON power-spectral-density (ACCEPTED); the board accepts parallel quantity edges from one source (cf. mel-spectrogram DEPENDS_ON spectrum, DEPENDS_ON magnitude-spectrum, DEPENDS_ON power-spectrum all ACCEPTED). Present-tense operation (Law 8), not identity or purpose.

The autocorrelation method is the canonical LPC formulation. LPC coefficients are derived by solving the Yule-Walker equations where the autocorrelation matrix and vector of the signal are the defining inputs. Remove autocorrelation and the standard autocorrelation method for computing LPC parameters loses its defining mathematical input.

Griffin-Lim iteratively estimates phase from magnitude spectrogram to reconstruct time-domain signal. Remove phase-retrieval capability and Griffin-Lim cannot operate; the algorithm's core loop is phase retrieval. Operational dependency.

Spectral envelope extraction requires FFT, smoothing, and peak detection — core signal processing primitives. Remove signal processing and spectral envelope has no extraction mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): phonetics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. The accepted phonetics definition carves it as a human-made discipline of linguistics studying the physical properties of speech sounds. Sibling precedent: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, syntax, morphology, semantics, pragmatics all accepted in this turn. Phonetics is the classical sibling discipline of phonology.

Cepstrum is defined as the IFFT of the log-magnitude spectrum. Removing log-magnitude-spectrum as a concept stops the cepstrum from having its defining mathematical operation — the cepstrum IS the IFFT of that specific signal.

Phonetics is the subsystem of language concerned with the physical production, acoustic properties, and perceptual processing of speech sounds. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics.

Semantics is the subsystem of language concerned with meaning — the mapping between linguistic forms and their interpretations. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and pragmatics, carving what linguistic expressions signify.

The cepstrum is defined as the IFFT of the logarithm of the magnitude spectrum. Remove the magnitude-spectrum concept and the cepstrum operation is structurally impossible — it has no input to transform.

CONTAINS = part-of: the variety is the whole, the accent is a constituent part. Dialect's accepted definition carves a variety as a bundle of component systems: '(1) phonological — distinctive sound patterns and pronunciation conventions; (2) lexical; (3) grammatical; (4) social index.' The phonological component of a variety is exactly what the accent category names: a dialect decomposes into accent ⊕ lexicon ⊕ grammar, and dialect atlases perform precisely this decomposition. Contrast with the struck prosody CONTAINS stress: there prosody is an analytic framework and stress a dimension it measures — analytic relation, not constituent. Here the relation is constitutive: a speaker can be characterized by accent alone while sharing the full dialect (the definition's own test), and the component is independently indexable — taught, tested, and atlased on its own. Pinned sense (Law 11d): accent as the phonological component of a variety per its isolation rule (same words, different sound).

Phonology is the subsystem of language concerned with the organization and patterning of speech sounds. It is a constitutive component of language alongside morphology, syntax, and semantics, governing sound system structure.

HPSS structurally requires the spectrogram: the algorithm operates on the spectrogram matrix, applying median filtering along time and frequency axes to separate harmonic from percussive components. Remove the spectrogram and HPSS has no data structure to decompose.

The cepstrum is a signal-processing technique operating on digital signals, applying quefrency-domain filtering, and outputting spectral estimates. Remove the broader signal-processing apparatus (FFT implementation, digital filtering, spectral estimation) and the cepstrum has no computational infrastructure to function within. Removal test: without signal-processing, cepstrum computation stops.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): semantics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names semantics as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and pragmatics. Semantics is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

Rhetoric is a specific kind of communication: it is communication deliberately structured to persuade. Direction test for INSTANCE_OF (Law 9/11e): rhetoric is a subtype of communication, distinguished by its intentional persuasive aim. All rhetoric is communication, but not all communication is rhetoric.

A Hamming window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.46 - 0.54*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (tapering a signal segment to reduce spectral leakage) — removing windowing stops the Hamming window from having its defining operation. This is a constitutive structural dependency: the Hamming window IS a window function, and without the concept of windowing it has no operational meaning.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): historical-linguistics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Per its accepted definition, historical-linguistics is a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora — one of the named subfields of the parent discipline. The accepted linguistics definition explicitly names 'historical linguistics' among its named subdisciplines. Parallel to accepted edges: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, phonetics. Pinned sense: historical-linguistics as the subdiscipline of language change over time.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is computational-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for formalizing linguistic knowledge in algorithms and computational models — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: computational-linguistics as the subdiscipline of computational language analysis.

CONTAINS = part-of, pinned to the discipline-as-collection sense: the board already ACCEPTED linguistics CONTAINS sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, and psycholinguistics, and INSTANCE_OF computational-linguistics -> linguistics; this files the fourth containment the family pattern implies, completing the set of subfields held inside the discipline.
Discourse is a subdomain of linguistics — the study of language beyond the sentence level. It encompasses cohesion, coherence, turn-taking, and conversational structure as linguistic phenomena.

Spectral analysis requires signal processing as a prerequisite — you cannot decompose a signal into its frequency components without the mathematical operations (FFT, windowing, etc.) that define signal processing. Removal test: without signal processing techniques, spectral analysis cannot operate.

Psycholinguistics investigates the cognitive mechanisms underlying language use — perception, production, acquisition, and representation. The removal test passes: remove cognition and psycholinguistics has no subject matter to operate on. This is not a meta-level claim (Law 2b); it is an object-level dependency where the discipline's entire investigative apparatus targets cognitive processes.

LPC as a speech science tool constitutively depends on the source-filter model: the model provides the interpretive framework (source=glottal flow, filter=vocal tract) that gives LPC its speech production meaning. Remove the source-filter model and LPC collapses to a generic linear regression procedure — it ceases operating as a speech analysis tool. The removal test (Law 8b) passes because the operational purpose of LPC in speech science is to estimate filter parameters within the source-filter framework.

Pinned sense: phase-locked vocoder as STFT-based algorithm with analysis/synthesis window length and hop size parameters. Removal test (Law 8): remove the Hann window function — the specific window shape used for spectral leakage control and overlap-add reconstruction — and the STFT frames the vocoder operates on lose their defined spectral leakage properties and overlap-add consistency; the algorithm's phase-locking rule operates on frames that no longer reconstruct correctly. The vocoder stops operating as a phase-coherent time-stretch/pitch-shift tool. Dependency is object-level material requirement for the STFT stage, not sayability.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): pragmatics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names pragmatics as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics. Pragmatics is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

Linguistic register is a specific subfield/concept within linguistics, the study of language varieties. It is a specific kind of linguistic object, not a part. INSTANCE_OF pins specific → general. The entry's scope describes language varieties, which is a topic linguistics studies.
An accent is a phonological construct — a recognizable pattern of phonetic realization. It is a specific variety of phonological production, making it an instance of the broader phonology category.

Source-filter model is a human-made mathematical model of speech production built explicitly for speech analysis, synthesis, and coding. Its parameters (source excitation, vocal tract filter, formant frequencies) are designed to serve speech-processing tasks such as speech synthesis, speech recognition, and speech coding. Remove speech-processing as a purpose and the model loses its designed application domain — it is maintained for whose sake speech processing operates. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve. The accepted speech-act definition is carved as 'a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action — promising, ordering, declaring, questioning — rather than merely describing a state of affairs': the speech act's bearer is the utterance, and parameter (1), the locutionary act, is 'the act of SAYING something' — saying something is the performing of an utterance. Remove utterance now — the unit participants treat as a single bounded unit of action, which the discipline transcribes and segments — and the speech act has no bearer to be an act OF: an action performed by an utterance is not an act performed by a bare span of sound or ink. The pragmatic framework stops classifying, because illocutionary force is force OF a unit, not of a continuum. Direction check (Law 8c): the converse fails — utterance operates without the speech-act taxonomy (a stretch is a bounded unit of action whether or not anyone classifies its illocutionary force), which is exactly why utterance DEPENDS_ON speech-act runs the wrong way and should fall. Pinned sense (Law 11d): speech act as the action performed BY an utterance per both accepted carves, not as a free-floating force in speech. Not DERIVED_FROM (utterance is not a historical source); not identity (the act is a way the unit functions, not the unit itself).

Whole-to-part (Law 10): neurolinguistics as a discipline contains speech-processing as a component research area. Per its accepted definition, neurolinguistics studies neural mechanisms of language acquisition, processing, representation, and comprehension — and speech-processing (the neural mechanisms by which speech sounds are perceived, decoded, and represented in the brain) is one of these core processes. The accepted speech-processing entry carves the computational and psychological study of how speech signals are transformed into linguistic representations. Neurolinguistics is the broader field that encompasses this component process alongside phonology, syntax, semantics, and other language-level operations. Direction test: neurolinguistics is the discipline whose scope comprises these component processes; speech-processing is one of them, not the whole.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): MFCC features are the log mel-frequency spectrum, which IS a spectral envelope representation (smoothed frequency-domain representation). Remove spectral envelope and MFCC loses its core characterizing concept — it cannot be understood as a spectral envelope without that concept. Constitutive.

Syntax is a specific component of grammar: a competent linguist calls syntax 'a part of grammar' or 'grammatical syntax'. Grammar is the broader system of rules for a language, encompassing syntax, morphology, phonology, etc. Direction specific→general is correct.

Power spectrum is the squared magnitude of the magnitude spectrum (|X(f)|^2). Removing magnitude-spectrum stops the power spectrum from having its defining operation — power spectrum is derived from magnitude spectrum by squaring.

In signal processing, phase refers to the angular component of the complex-valued Fourier transform output. The phase spectrum is defined as the argument of the Fourier transform at each frequency bin. Without the Fourier transform, there is no signal processing phase concept — phase is not a standalone construct but an inherent property of Fourier spectral analysis.

Linear predictive coding models the vocal tract as an all-pole filter whose coefficients directly represent the spectral envelope. The LPC analysis estimates the spectral envelope of speech by predicting each sample from a linear combination of past samples. Remove the spectral-envelope concept and LPC has no target to model — its output coefficients are a parametric representation of the spectral envelope.

Parameters: (1) LPC order — number of prediction coefficients (determines envelope resolution); (2) analysis window — frame size for prediction.

Laws: 6, 8b

The wavelet transform is a Fourier-related transform that decomposes signals using scaled and shifted wavelet basis functions. The mathematical theory of wavelets is deeply intertwined with Fourier analysis — wavelet properties (localization, frequency interpretation, reconstruction) are defined in relation to Fourier transform behavior. The Fourier transform provides the frequency domain framework that gives wavelet coefficients their spectral meaning. Removing the Fourier transform concept eliminates the analytical context that defines the wavelet transform.

Removal test (Law 8b): formant-tracking, per its accepted definition, is 'a computational method that estimates the time-varying resonant frequencies of the vocal tract from speech signals by detecting spectral peaks in successive analysis frames.' Its object of operation is the formant itself — the vocal-tract resonant frequency band, per formant's accepted definition ('a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter'). Remove formant — the resonance that produces the trackable spectral peaks — and formant-tracking stops operating: the peak-picking has nothing to lock onto and the output (the time-varying resonant-frequency contour) ceases to exist. Not mere sayability: the method's mechanism presupposes the resonant band as the structure it measures. Same accepted shape as pitch-tracking DEPENDS_ON F0 (remove F0 as a concept and pitch tracking has nothing to track). Not DERIVED_FROM: the formant concept is the object tracked, not a historical source — the method's historical sources (spectral-analysis, cepstral-analysis) are already filed as its DERIVED_FROM edges. Pinned senses: formant as the vocal-tract resonant frequency band (accepted definition); formant-tracking as the frame-by-frame estimation method (accepted definition).

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is neurolinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is a field that studies the neural and biological mechanisms of language — a specific subfield within the broader discipline of linguistics. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind interposes). Pinned sense: neurolinguistics as the research program mapping language onto brain mechanisms.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): psycholinguistics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Per its accepted definition, psycholinguistics is a disciplinary framework for mapping mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition — one of the named subfields of the parent discipline. The accepted linguistics definition explicitly names 'psycholinguistics' among its named subdisciplines. Parallel to accepted edges: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, phonetics. Pinned sense: psycholinguistics as the subdiscipline of cognitive language processing.

Rhetoric as a practice contains narrative as a tool: the deployment of story and sequenced events is one of the core techniques within the rhetorical repertoire. Direction test: rhetoric is the broader practice that incorporates narrative as one of its methods. Narrative within rhetoric serves persuasion; narrative outside rhetoric serves other ends.

LPC computation requires the autocorrelation matrix as its core input: the Yule-Walker equations are solved via the Levinson-Durbin recursion applied to the signal's autocorrelation sequence. Remove autocorrelation and the LPC algorithm has no data to solve — the prediction coefficients cannot be computed. The definition carves this step explicitly. Operational dependency (Law 8b), distinct from the historical DERIVED_FROM that already records that autocorrelation predates LPC.

A formant IS a specific acoustic resonance — a peak in the speech spectrum corresponding to a vocal tract cavity resonance. Resonance is the accepted nearest kind (formant already has DEPENDS_ON and DERIVED_FROM to/from resonance), making this the missing INSTANCE_OF link on the kind ladder.

Direction test (Law 9): discourse is a specific kind of linguistics — the subdiscipline studying language use beyond the sentence level, including conversation structure, coherence, and contextual meaning. A competent linguist calls discourse analysis "a part of linguistics" or "discourse linguistics." INSTANCE_OF runs specific→general, and linguistics is the nearest accepted kind. Pinned sense: discourse as the linguistics subdiscipline of language use in context.

The source-filter model decomposes speech into source and filter components, where the filter is the vocal tract transfer function that produces formants. Formants are peaks in the spectral envelope — the model's filter component is defined by its shaping of the spectral envelope. Remove spectral-envelope and the model's filter concept (formant shaping) has no structural framework to operate. The removal test passes.

Prosody is a subdomain of phonology — the study of suprasegmental features (stress, intonation, tone, rhythm). The accepted prosody definition carves it as a systematic framework of pitch, loudness, and duration patterns; this IS a phonological construct, just operating above the segmental level.

MFCC warps the frequency axis onto the mel scale before computing power spectrum and cepstral coefficients. Remove the mel-scale mapping and the MFCC pipeline cannot operate as defined. The mel-scale frequency warping is a constitutive step in the MFCC computation.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): vocabulary per its accepted definition — the structured inventory of the words and terms that a language, register, or discipline employs; word per its accepted definition — a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes, organized by convention to carry specific meaning. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): an inventory contains its items, and the vocabulary definition explicitly carves it as 'the structured inventory of words and terms' — the words it organizes are the constituent items of the whole. Remove the words and the inventory is empty: the whole is constituted by its items. The part is not dependent on the container for its operation (Law 8c: identity is not dependency) — word DEPENDS_ON language stands on its own, and words persist in use regardless of any inventory. The board has already ruled vocabulary a kind of catalog (vocabulary INSTANCE_OF catalog accepted); a catalog contains its entries. Direction whole→part is consistent with the accepted language CONTAINS vocabulary one level up.

Formant frequencies are vocal tract resonances — they exist only because the vocal tract acts as an acoustic cavity with specific geometry. The removal test (Law 8b): remove the vocal tract and formant frequencies cease to exist. Formants are not independent acoustic phenomena; they are produced by and inseparable from the vocal tract filter. This is a constitutive dependency.

Historical linguistics studies language change across time. The removal test passes: remove chronology (the ordered sequence of temporal events) and historical linguistics loses its temporal dimension entirely, ceasing to operate as a discipline. Pinned sense: chronology as the framework of ordered temporal relations that makes historical analysis possible.

LPC is fundamentally a linear algebra problem: solving the Yule-Walker equations via matrix inversion to estimate prediction coefficients. Without linear algebra, LPC has no computational mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes.

Sociolect provides social-indexical linguistic resources that discourse actors deploy. The sociolect is built for the sake of enabling contextually appropriate discourse — speakers draw on sociolectal conventions to perform social positioning within discourse. SERVES: sociolect (resource/tool) → discourse (practice that uses it). Law 8d: servant points at master.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): Cepstrum computation requires the STFT to produce the log-magnitude spectrum that the cepstrum operates on. Remove STFT and the cepstrum loses its computational mechanism — it cannot compute quefrency without the time-frequency decomposition STFT provides. Constitutive.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): working-memory per its accepted definition — a bounded system for the temporary storage and manipulation of information (capacity-limited ~4±1 chunks, time-limited, domain-general, sustained by attentional control and rehearsal loops); memory per its accepted definition — structured retention and retrieval of information across time, parameterized by encoding, storage, retrieval, and fidelity. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): the memory system's storage parameter decomposes into its component stores — temporary (working) and durable (long-term) — and the court has already accepted working-memory as a kind of memory (INSTANCE_OF). Working memory is a component of the whole: it performs the temporary-storage-and-manipulation function the whole's storage parameter requires during complex cognition. Part, not identity (Law 8c): remove working memory and memory still operates — durable retention and retrieval across time persist — so this is part-of, not DEPENDS_ON. The board's subfield convention accepts both edge kinds on the same pair (syntax INSTANCE_OF linguistics and linguistics CONTAINS syntax are both accepted).

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is psycholinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: psycholinguistics as the subdiscipline of cognitive language processing.

The magnitude spectrum is structurally derived from the power spectrum: magnitude = sqrt(power spectrum). Remove the power-spectrum concept and the magnitude spectrum loses its defining computational relationship — there is no power concept from which to derive magnitudes.

Parameters: none intrinsic; magnitude is the square-root transformation of power spectral density.

Laws: 6, 8b

Removal test (Law 8b): semantics is, per its accepted definition, the study of meaning-mapping within a sign system. Remove the language entry — the system of symbolic signs — and meaning-mapping has no domain: no sign system, no semantics to map. The discipline's instrument ceases, so the discipline stops operating. Complements the already-accepted semantics DEPENDS_ON syntax (syntax being the combinatorial part of the sign system) and follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield (grammar, phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, discourse, rhetoric). Pinned sense: the discipline as the study of meaning within a sign system.

The DCT is a Fourier-related transform that uses a subset of the Fourier transform basis functions with specific symmetry conditions. The DCT computes real-valued frequency coefficients by exploiting the even-symmetry extension of input data, which is fundamentally a Fourier transform construction. Removing the Fourier transform concept eliminates the mathematical framework from which the DCT is derived.

Stress as a linguistic phenomenon depends on the prosodic framework — it is realized through prosodic mechanisms (pitch, duration, intensity variation) and functions within prosodic organization. Without the prosodic system that provides prominence dimensions, stress as a linguistic contrast cannot operate.

Removal test (Law 8b) against both accepted definitions: pitch-detection's accepted definition carves its operating purpose as 'a computational technique that estimates the fundamental frequency (F0) of a periodic or quasi-periodic signal,' with algorithm classes (autocorrelation, cepstral, FFT-based, hybrid, learning-based) that are all F0-estimation methods and an output resolution in hertz of the F0 estimate. fundamental-frequency's accepted definition carves F0 as 'the lowest frequency of a periodic waveform' and persists through exactly these estimation algorithms (YIN, SWIPE, pYIN) and pitch-tracking conventions. Remove fundamental-frequency - the periodic cycle rate the method locks onto - and pitch-detection stops operating: the peak-picking has nothing to lock onto and the output (the F0 estimate, the pitch contour) ceases to exist. Not mere sayability: the mechanism presupposes the periodic cycle rate as the structure it measures. Not identity (Law 8c): F0 is the quantity estimated, not the technique renamed. Not purpose (Law 8d). Same accepted shape as pitch-tracking DEPENDS_ON fundamental-frequency (ACCEPTED; the time-varying twin carves the identical 'estimates the fundamental frequency (F0)' purpose), and the same test as formant-tracking DEPENDS_ON formant (pending, filed by me). Not DERIVED_FROM: the F0 concept is the object estimated, not a historical source - the technique's historical line is already filed as DERIVED_FROM signal-processing. Pinned senses: pitch-detection as the F0-estimation technique (accepted definition); fundamental-frequency as the lowest frequency of a periodic waveform (accepted definition).

Narrative is a specific kind of discourse: it is discourse organized around a sequence of events with a structured temporal arc. Direction test for INSTANCE_OF (Law 9/11e): narrative is a subtype of discourse, distinguished by its sequential event structure and temporal organization. All narratives are discourse, but not all discourse is narrative.

Spectral-envelope is the smooth curve tracing peak amplitudes across frequencies. It is computed by signal processing algorithms (smoothing of the magnitude spectrum, interpolation, etc.). Remove signal-processing and spectral-envelope has no computational method to exist or be derived. The removal test passes.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is corpus-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is an approach to linguistics that studies language patterns through systematic analysis of large, representative collections of real-language data — a specific methodological framework within the discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: corpus-linguistics as the empirical subdiscipline studying language through annotated text collections and statistical analysis.

Rhetoric as the art and study of effective communication contains argument as a core component: the structured deployment of claims with support is the mechanism by which rhetorical persuasion operates. Direction test: rhetoric is the broader discipline/practice that encompasses argument; argument is a part of rhetoric, not the other way around. Rhetoric CONTAINS argument because argument is one of the tools within the rhetorical repertoire.

Speech acts are a fundamental pragmatics construct. The pragmatic function of language — how utterances perform actions (promises, declarations, requests) — is exactly what speech-act theory studies. This IS a pragmatics-level construct, not a generic "language" dependency.

Premeditation is deliberation performed in advance of an action. Direction test for DEPENDS_ON (Law 2b/8b): remove deliberation and premeditation ceases to operate — premeditation IS deliberation (the forward-looking kind), so without the capacity to deliberate, premeditation cannot exist. The dependency is definitional: premeditation derives its operation from the general capacity for deliberation, applied temporally.

INTONATION operates through F0 contours: the definition explicitly carves 'the way fundamental frequency rises and falls across the duration of an utterance.' F0 is the physical substrate that intonation patterns modulate. Removal test: remove F0 and intonation loses its mechanism — pitch contours have no physical referent. Not DERIVED_FROM (F0 is the object of operation, not a historical source). Not identity (F0 is the quantity being patterned, not the pattern itself). Direction: intonation depends on F0; F0 operates independently without intonation.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): historical-linguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the language systems that historical linguistics reconstructs and the attested corpora it uses — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no diachronic changes to reconstruct, no attested corpora, no comparative method, no sound change laws. The discipline's operations have nothing to operate on. Object-level dependency on language. Sibling precedent: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language.

Memory as a cognitive capacity contains recall as a core process: the act of retrieving stored information is one of the fundamental operations of memory. Direction test for CONTAINS: memory is the broader capacity that encompasses encoding, storage, and recall; recall is a distinct component process within the memory system. The mechanism of recall (retrieval from storage) operates as part of the general memory function.

Grammar as a linguistic system comprises several component sub-systems: phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics. Phonology (the study of sound patterns) is literally a part within the grammatical system — one of its core components. Whole-and-part relation: grammar CONTAINS phonology as a constitutive sub-system.

An argument is a structured reasoning construct consisting of premises and a conclusion. Premises ARE literal parts of an argument — the supporting claims that, together with the conclusion, constitute the argument's structure. Remove the premises and the argument collapses; they are constitutive components within the whole. Whole-and-part relation: argument CONTAINS premise.

Removal test (Law 8b): historical-linguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no language systems to reconstruct, no sound change laws to state, no attested corpora to analyze. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.

The discrete cosine transform (DCT) computes real-valued frequency coefficients using discrete sinusoidal basis functions — specifically, it applies the discrete Fourier transform to a real symmetric extension of the input. Removing the concept of discrete fourier transform stops the DCT from having its defining mathematical operation. The DCT IS a variant of the DFT; without DFT as a foundation, the DCT has no operational meaning.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): psycholinguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the mental representations and processes that psycholinguistics maps — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no production/comprehension/acquisition processes to study, no lexical access patterns, no syntactic parsing, no processing models, no developmental stages. The discipline's operations collapse. Object-level dependency on language. Sibling precedent: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language.

Removal test (Law 8b): sociolinguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no linguistic variables to correlate with social structure. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve. The accepted dialect definition carves a dialect as 'a variety OF A LANGUAGE distinguished by systematic differences in phonology, lexicon, and grammar' — its genus is language, and its own parameters are parameters of a sign system: (1) phonological — sound patterns and pronunciation conventions; (2) lexical — vocabulary items; (3) grammatical — syntactic structures and morphological patterns. Remove language now (the maintained system of symbolic signs) and 'a variety of a language' has no genus to vary: what remains is idiosyncratic vocalization without shared conventions, and none of the dialect's parameters — sound conventions, vocabulary items, syntactic structures — can be distinguished, since they are distinguished against the shared system. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being sayable: the variety is a unit of the sign system, exactly as utterance, phrase, and speech-act are. Same accepted shape as speech-act DEPENDS_ON language and discourse DEPENDS_ON language, both standing; dialect INSTANCE_OF language (accepted) marks the kind, this edge marks the operation. Direction check: language operates without the notion of dialect (a language stands even where no regional variety is carved), so the dependency runs dialect→language, not the reverse. Pinned sense (Law 11d): dialect as a variety of a language per its filed carve.

Removal test (Law 8b): the accepted definition of vocoder carves its first operating parameter as 'the analysis stage decomposing the signal into components - classically a glottal source plus a vocal-tract filter, in spectral vocoders a frame of STFT magnitude and phase', with the transmitted parameter set being 'spectral envelope plus excitation, or per-frame spectral coefficients'. STFT frames and spectral coefficients are the output of exactly the practice spectral-analysis's accepted definition names: decomposing a signal into its constituent frequency components via a mathematical transform (Fourier, wavelet, STFT). Remove spectral-analysis - the transform-based decomposition into frequency components - and the vocoder loses its analysis stage: there is no mechanism left to produce the parametric representation, and the synthesis stage (parameter 3) has nothing to reconstruct from. The technique stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Not DERIVED_FROM: spectral-analysis is not a historical source of the vocoder (the founding lines are the Fletcher source-filter vocoders and the phase vocoder); this is present-tense operational dependence. Precedent: both accepted nearest subkinds already hold this exact edge - phase-vocoder DEPENDS_ON spectral-analysis and formant-vocoder DEPENDS_ON spectral-analysis (both ACCEPTED) - the general kind carries the edge its accepted members carry. Pinned senses: vocoder as the analyze-manipulate-resynthesize technique with spectral parametric representation (accepted definition); spectral-analysis as the transform-based frequency decomposition practice (accepted definition).

The mel scale maps frequencies to a perceptual scale using the formula: mel = 2595 * log10(1 + f/700). This logarithmic transformation is constitutive of the mel scale itself — removing the concept of logarithm stops the mel scale from having its defining mathematical operation. The mel scale IS defined by this logarithmic mapping; without logarithm it has no operational meaning.

Cepstral-coefficients are the coefficients used in speech recognition and audio processing. They are computed via cepstrum analysis which involves matrix operations and linear algebra techniques. Remove linear-algebra and cepstral-coefficients cannot be computed. The removal test passes.

Spectral envelope is the smooth curve that traces the peaks of the magnitude spectrum. Removing magnitude-spectrum stops the spectral-envelope from having any data to trace — there is no spectral content to envelope.

Morphology studies word formation and the structure of words from morphemes. Lexicon is the stored inventory of words and morphemes that morphology operates upon. Removal test: remove the lexicon and morphology has no material to analyze or combine — no stored forms to decompose or build. The dependency is constitutive: morphology is the study and manipulation of lexically stored morphological material.

Prosody is a phonetic phenomenon that operates only through spoken language. Removing speech-processing (the cognitive mechanism for perceiving, producing, and interpreting speech) would stop prosody from operating — prosody depends on the capacity for speech processing as its operational substrate.

Discourse is the phenomenon of language extended beyond single utterances — it is inherently a form of communication. Removal test: remove communication and discourse ceases to operate, since discourse IS multi-utterance communication. The dependency is constitutive at the object level: discourse is not merely associated with communication; it is communication operating over extended stretches of talk/text.

Removal test (Law 8b): remove the language system (the accepted definition: the human-made system of symbolic signs structured for encoding, transmitting, and decoding meaning) and the field's object of study disappears — the neural mechanisms that implement language no longer exist, because there is no language to implement. The paradigm methods named in the accepted definition (fMRI/EEG mapping of language tasks, lesion-symptom mapping in aphasia patients) lose the very tasks that define them: the field stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Same shape as the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield: phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, linguistics itself. Pinned sense: the field of study, not its practitioners.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b). speech-processing's accepted definition carves its parameters as: (1) representation domain (time-domain waveform, short-time Fourier transform, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, linear prediction coefficients), (2) temporal scale, (3) task objective. These representations — STFT, MFCC, LPC — are all signal-processing constructs. Remove signal-processing and speech-processing loses its operational techniques: no FFT, no filter design, no spectral analysis — the discipline has no computational mechanisms left. This is an operational dependency, not a generic "every entry needs X" appeal: signal-processing is the specific methodological substrate named in the definition.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is sociolinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: sociolinguistics as the subdiscipline of social language variation.

Spectral bandwidth structurally requires the power spectrum: it is computed as the square root of the second central moment of the power spectrum around the spectral centroid. Remove the power spectrum and spectral bandwidth has no data to compute.

CONTAINS is part-whole (Law 10). Pinned sense: register analysis as a research area within the discipline — the accepted definition of linguistic-register says so explicitly: 'the map persists as the stable sub-field of linguistics called register analysis, its dimensions codified in textbooks and corpora.' A subfield of the discipline is a part of it, alongside the accepted parts (phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, lexicography, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, neurolinguistics). Complements the accepted linguistic-register INSTANCE_OF linguistics (nearest kind), exactly as the accepted subfield pairs do.

Spectral flux quantifies the frame-to-frame rate of change of the spectral energy distribution. In audio analysis, this is computed directly from a spectrogram — the sequence of power spectra over time. Removing the spectrogram concept eliminates the data structure from which spectral flux is derived; the measure cannot operate without it.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): neurolinguistics as a discipline contains speech-intelligibility as a component research area. Speech-intelligibility — the degree to which speech is understood by a listener — is one of the phenomena studied within neurolinguistics alongside phonology, syntax, and semantics. The accepted neurolinguistics definition carves its scope as neural mechanisms of language processing, and speech-intelligibility is a measurable aspect of language processing that neurolinguistics investigates via EEG, fMRI, and lesion studies. Direction test: neurolinguistics is the broader discipline; speech-intelligibility is a specific phenomenon it studies as a component part.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): morphology is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the discipline definition explicitly names morphology as one of its constituent subfields. Morphology is a part of linguistics conceptual and institutional structure.

DERIVED_FROM: STFT as a computational method predates and underlies the cepstrum. The cepstrum (Bogert, Healy & Tukey, 1960s) uses log magnitude spectrum computed via STFT. The cepstrum was derived as a method to analyze signals using the log-spectra that STFT provides.

STFT structurally requires a window function: the algorithm frames the signal by multiplying each frame with the window (Hann, Hamming, etc.). Remove the window-function concept and the STFT cannot perform its framing operation - it has no mechanism to taper spectral leakage at frame boundaries. The removal test passes mechanically.

Parameters: (1) window type - the tapering function shape; (2) window length - samples per frame. Persistence mechanism: algorithmic application of the window function to each signal frame.

Laws: 6, 8b

INTONATION is the organization of pitch in speech: the definition explicitly carves 'the systematic, rule-governed framework by which utterances use rising and falling pitch.' Pitch is the perceptual attribute that intonation patterns modulate. Removal test: remove pitch and intonation loses its perceptual substrate — the rising and falling patterns have nothing to be patterns OF. Not DERIVED_FROM (pitch is the object being patterned, not a historical source). Direction: intonation depends on pitch; pitch operates without intonation (e.g., monotonous speech still has pitch). Note: this is the perceptual counterpart to the intonation→fundamental-frequency edge, which covers the physical substrate (F0).

Sociolect IS a specific kind of language-variety at the group level. The accepted language-variety definition explicitly lists sociolect. Distinguished by social boundary rather than geography (dialect) or situation (register). Nearest kind: language-variety per Law 9/11e.

Removal test (Law 8b): psycholinguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no production, comprehension, or acquisition to study. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): The source-filter model's filter component is characterized by the spectral envelope — it is the spectral envelope that represents the vocal tract transfer function. Remove spectral envelope and the model loses its mechanism for representing the filter. The source-filter model cannot operate without this concept.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): morpheme per its accepted definition as the minimal meaningful unit of a language. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the system of structured signs in which morphemes exist as minimal meaningful units — and the category has no domain to operate in. Per its own definition, a morpheme is language-relative: its identity as a minimal meaningful unit is constituted by the grammatical system of a specific language. Without language, the morpheme loses its entire parameter set (minimality, meaningfulness, language-relativity) and ceases to operate as the unit it is. Not generic: this is not the meta-level claim that 'concepts need language to be said.' This is object-level: the morpheme's carve is specifically about language's grammatical system. Sibling precedent: lexeme DEPENDS_ON language (accepted pattern). This matches the board's accepted pattern: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language, linguistics DEPENDS_ON language — each is a discipline or category whose object is language itself.

MFCC is computed by applying a mel filterbank to the magnitude spectrum, taking log, then computing DCT to produce cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstrum operation and MFCC loses its core computational mechanism; the coefficients cannot be produced. Operational dependency, not just conceptual.

Removal test (Law 8): remove language — speech-acts cease to operate. A speech-act is an utterance that performs an action (promising, asserting, commanding, etc.). Its entire nature is linguistic — it is an act constituted by language use. Removing language removes the medium through which speech-acts are performed, constituted, and recognized. This is object-level: speech-acts are defined as linguistic actions, not as general actions that happen to sometimes use language.

Pinned sense: the linguistic sense, which the target's accepted definition carves — the system of situationally differentiated language varieties a speech community deploys for different communicative situations (colloquial, formal, technical, ceremonial, professional). Removal test (Law 8b): remove linguistic-register and discourse survives as bare utterance, but it no longer operates as the conventionally structured form its own accepted definition carves ('follows rules of relevance, tone, register, and genre specific to a community or institution') — the register-selection rule that structures its varieties has no referent, so discourse ceases operating as the thing it is carved to be. Present-tense operational dependency, not historical provenance. This is the corrected pairing the just-ruled challenge on discourse —DEPENDS_ON→ register pointed to: the filer's note pinned the linguistic sense but the target was the bureaucratic register; the entry that actually holds the pinned sense is linguistic-register.

A Hann window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (the operation of tapering a signal segment) — removing windowing stops the Hann window from being a meaningful concept, as its entire purpose and definition is as a window function used in windowed-signal processing.

Corrected direction of the struck formant/spectral-envelope pair (Law 8b removal test). Accepted formant def: 'a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter' — a formant is by definition a peak WITHIN the spectral envelope. Accepted spectral-envelope def: 'the overall shape of a sound's frequency spectrum... the macroscopic profile... measured by smoothing the power spectrum (via cepstral analysis, linear predictive coding)'. Removal test: remove the spectral-envelope concept and the formant loses the surface on which it is defined, because it is defined as a peak in the envelope; without the envelope a formant has no referent to be a peak of. This is the constructive correction to the misfiled spectral-envelope to formant direction, which failed the test (smoothing the power spectrum yields the envelope without formants). Direction pinned per Law 11d to the two accepted definitions.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): sociolinguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the system of linguistic variation that sociolinguistics maps — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no speech communities, no social variables, no linguistic variables, no interactional context to study. The discipline's operations have nothing to operate on. This is object-level, not meta-level: the sociolinguistics definition specifically carves language as its subject matter, not just any domain. Sibling precedent: the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language, linguistics DEPENDS_ON language — each is a discipline whose domain is language.

Pragmatics is the subsystem of language concerned with context-dependent meaning and the principles governing language use in communication. It is a constitutive component of language, governing how linguistic forms are deployed in situated interaction.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve: utterance is 'a contiguous stretch of speech or writing treated by its participants as a single, bounded unit of communicative action' — a unit of the sign system. Remove language (the system of signs) and the stretch of speech or writing is no longer a sign-event: what remains is vocalization or ink marks, and no unit of communicative action can be treated, transcribed, or annotated, because treating a stretch as a communicative unit requires that the stretch SAY something. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Same accepted shape as speech-act DEPENDS_ON language (accepted: 'utterances as meaningful sign-events no longer exist — what remains is acoustic or gestural behavior without illocutionary force') and discourse DEPENDS_ON language. Direction: the utterance-unit needs language; language operates without the notion of an utterance-unit. Pinned sense: utterance as bounded unit of communicative action within the sign system, not mere physical span.

A Blackman window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.42 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)) + 0.08*cos(4*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (tapering a signal segment to reduce spectral leakage) — removing windowing stops the Blackman window from having its defining operation. This is a constitutive structural dependency: the Blackman window IS a window function, and without the concept of windowing it has no operational meaning.

Reasoning is the cognitive faculty that draws conclusions, makes inferences, and solves problems through systematic thought. It is a core component of the cognitive system alongside memory, attention, perception, and language, governing higher-order thought processes.

The source-filter model contains the glottal-source as its source component (Law 10): the model decomposes speech production into source (glottal airflow) and filter (vocal tract resonance). The glottal-source is a constitutive part of the model — removing it eliminates the other half of the model's structure. CONTAINS test: the glottal-source is a part of the source-filter model.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is text-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is a discipline that studies extended stretches of language (texts, discourses) as structured wholes — a specific subfield within the discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: text-linguistics as the subdiscipline studying textual coherence, cohesion, and organization.

The glottal-source model constitutively depends on fundamental frequency as its primary parameter: F0 specifies the vibration rate of the vocal folds and determines the pitch of the source. Remove F0 from the model and the glottal source loses its defining characteristic — it becomes an undifferentiated airflow with no periodicity. The removal test (Law 8b) passes: without the parameter F0, the model cannot specify which voice it produces.

Removal test (Law 8b): a speech act is, per its accepted definition, 'a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action — promising, ordering, declaring, questioning'. The utterance is an instance of the sign system: remove the language entry and utterances as meaningful sign-events no longer exist — what remains is acoustic or gestural behavior without illocutionary force, and no promising, ordering, declaring, or questioning can be PERFORMED, because performing them requires a system of signs. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being articulable. Constitutive dependency of the same accepted shape as discourse DEPENDS_ON language and rhetoric DEPENDS_ON language. Pinned sense: utterance-as-action (parameters: locutionary, illocutionary, perlocutionary), not the bare psychological effect — perlocutionary effects are parameter 3 and can follow any stimulus.

LPC was developed to solve the inverse problem of the source-filter model: given a speech signal, estimate the vocal tract filter parameters that produced it. The LPC algorithm operates by modeling the source-filter relationship — removing it removes the theoretical foundation of the method. Historical (1960s) and structural dependency.

Removal test (Law 8b): the accepted definition carves linguistic register as 'the map of the system of situationally differentiated language varieties a speech community develops and maintains', persisting as the stable sub-field of register analysis. Remove the language system — the system of symbolic signs — and the map has no territory: there are no varieties of a sign system to inventory, and the sub-field loses its object. The varieties persist as social conventions OF a sign system and the map persists as a subfield OF linguistics; both presuppose the sign system they organize. Follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield (phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, linguistics). Pinned sense: the map and its sub-field, not individual utterances.

FFT is an algorithm for computing the discrete Fourier transform. It implements the Fourier transform in O(n log n) time. Removing Fourier-transform as a concept stops FFT from having its mathematical foundation — FFT IS a specific efficient implementation of Fourier transform.

Stress is a core component of prosody — the syllable-level prominence dimension. Prosody as a suprasegmental system contains stress (syllable prominence), pitch contour (intonation), duration patterns (rhythm), and intensity variations as its constituent dimensions.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is speech-intelligibility a specific kind of cognitive-phenomenon? Yes. Speech-intelligibility — the degree to which speech is understood by a listener — is a cognitive phenomenon arising from the interaction of acoustic processing and language comprehension in the brain. Cognitive-phenomenon is the general kind of mind-substrate events and processes that this construct maps. Nearest accepted kind: cognitive-phenomenon (no intermediate kind interposes). Pinned sense: speech-intelligibility as the measurable phenomenon of how well speech is understood.

SERVES test (Law 8d: servant→master). prosody's accepted definition: "Prosody is the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns in spoken language." This framework provides the analytical categories (pitch contour, loudness, duration, syllable count) that phonetics uses to measure physical speech-sound properties. For whose sake? Phonetics — the discipline of physical speech-sound analysis. prosody (servant/analytical framework) → phonetics (master/user of the framework). The phonetics definition carves its method as "analysis proceeds by measurement and cross-linguistic description" — prosody provides the analytical categories for those measurements.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): linguistic-register is the variety of language deployed according to setting, purpose, and participant relationships — one specific type of language-variety alongside dialect, sociolect, idiolect. Nearest accepted kind: language-variety.

Spectral flatness (or Wiener entropy) is computed as the ratio of the geometric mean to the arithmetic mean of the power spectral density: 10*log10(geometric mean / arithmetic mean). The logarithm is constitutive to this definition — it is used to compute the geometric mean and to express the final result. Removing logarithm stops the spectral flatness concept from having its defining mathematical operation.

Grammar as a formal rule system depends on computation — grammars are defined as computational devices that compute whether strings belong to a language and derive their structure. The rules of grammar operate as algorithms (computational procedures). Removing computation (the formal mechanism for systematic state transformation) would stop grammar from operating as a formal system.

Power spectrum is the squared magnitude of the magnitude spectrum as a function of frequency: |X(f)|². Frequency is the domain variable that gives the power spectrum its structural meaning — removing frequency stops the power spectrum from having a coordinate system or operational definition. The power spectrum IS a mapping from frequency to power; without frequency as a concept, this mapping has no meaning.

Removal test (Law 8b): lexicography compiles, defines, and records the lexicon of a language — its accepted definition ties the practice to the vocabulary of a sign system, and the board has already accepted lexicography DEPENDS_ON dictionary (the record) and lexicography INSTANCE_OF linguistics. Remove the language system and there is no lexicon to compile: the dictionary-making practice loses its object and stops operating. Follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield (grammar, phonology, morphology, semantics-adjacent, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics). Pinned sense: lexicography as the practice of documenting a language's lexicon.

Syntax is the subsystem of language concerned with the rules and principles governing the combination of linguistic elements into well-formed structures. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, and semantics, governing structural composition.

Cepstral coefficients are values defined in the quefrency domain — they are the output of the cepstrum operation which transforms from the frequency domain to the quefrency domain. Removing the concept of quefrency stops the cepstral coefficients from having their defining domain of operation. The quefrency domain IS the structural space in which cepstral coefficients exist and operate.

The STFT operates by dividing a signal into overlapping frames and applying the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) to each frame. The DFT is the core computational mechanism — STFT is literally DFT applied to windowed segments. Removing the DFT concept eliminates the mathematical operation that defines STFT; the technique cannot operate without it.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): syntax is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names syntax as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, semantics, and pragmatics. Syntax is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

Cepstral coefficients ARE the spectral envelope represented in the cepstral domain. Remove the spectral-envelope concept and cepstral coefficients lose their defining property — they would be uninterpretable mathematical values with no signal-theoretic meaning. The spectral envelope is constitutive to what cepstral coefficients represent.

Grammar is the whole system of rules for a language, and syntax is one of its constituent components (alongside morphology, phonology, semantics). Grammar contains syntax in the part-of sense of Law 10: syntax is a part inside the whole grammar. Pinned sense: grammar as a structured system of linguistic rules, syntax as its sentence-structure subcomponent.

DEPENDS_ON (Law 8b removal test against both accepted definitions): the source-filter model decomposes the speech signal into a source component, glottal airflow with F0, and a filter component, the vocal-tract transfer function shaped by formant frequencies and bandwidths. Remove formant and the filter has no formant structure to model - the source-plus-filter decomposition stops characterizing speech, because the filter's defining parameters are the formants. Not identity, formant is the resonance and the model is the decomposition framework; not purpose, that is SERVES which speech-processing already holds; not DERIVED_FROM, formant is not a historical source of the model. Same accepted shape as formant-vocoder DEPENDS_ON formant and formant-tracking DEPENDS_ON formant, both standing.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is historical-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: historical-linguistics as the subdiscipline of language change over time.

Phase-vocoder was developed as a signal-processing technique for pitch and time-scale modification. Which-came-first test passed: signal-processing methods existed first; phase-vocoder was derived from them.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to general): stress as a rule-governed prominence system of a language is a specific kind of prosodic system. Prosody's accepted definition explicitly names 'stress ... patterns in spoken language' as its domain; meter already stands as an accepted INSTANCE_OF prosody (a rule-governed pattern-system within the prosodic framework), and intonation INSTANCE_OF prosody stands with 4 of 5 judges on the same family logic. A competent phonologist calls stress 'a prosodic system' — the stress system: which syllables are prominent, rule-governed. Nearest kind: prosody (not phonology — that is the discipline, a topic is not an instance of its discipline; not speech — too far). Pinned sense (Law 11d): stress as the rule-governed prominence system of a language (stress patterns and rules), not bare phonetic prominence in a single utterance. This is kind-of, not the part-of that the struck prosody CONTAINS stress attempted: a stress system is a kind of prosodic system, as meter is.

Computational linguistics uses computational models and algorithms to study language processing, acquisition, and structure. The removal test passes: remove computation and computational linguistics has no methodology to operate with. Pinned sense: computation as the formal manipulation of symbols according to rules, which is the constitutive methodology of computational linguistics.

Corrected direction of the filed fundamental-frequency DEPENDS_ON glottal-source pair (Law 8b removal test on the DEFINED senses). Accepted glottal-source def: a human-made model of the glottal airflow source in speech production, describing the periodic excitation generated by vocal fold vibration; its parameters are fundamental frequency, open quotient, asymmetry coefficient, return phase - F0 is named in the definition as the model's core parameter. Accepted F0 def: the rate at which the sound source repeats its cycle; in speech it corresponds to vocal fold vibration rate. Removal test: remove fundamental-frequency and the glottal-source model has no periodic cycle to model - the open quotient, asymmetry and return phase are all defined relative to the glottal cycle, and the excitation the model produces loses its defining parameter; the model stops operating as a model of glottal airflow. The reverse direction fails: remove the glottal-source model and F0 (lowest frequency of a periodic waveform, estimated by autocorrelation, cepstral, peak-picking) computes identically - the note on the filed edge itself frames the dependency as meaning, not operation (Law 8c). Not identity (the model is the framework, F0 is the parameter), not DERIVED_FROM (the model is not a historical source of the quantity). Direction pinned per Law 11d to both accepted definitions.

Removal test (Law 8): remove language — phrases cease to operate. A phrase is a linguistic unit: a group of words functioning as a coherent unit within a sentence. Its entire existence and operation is within a language system. Removing language removes all linguistic units — phrases, words, morphemes — because they are constitutive parts of language, not merely concepts that need language to be described. This is object-level (Law 2b): phrase is defined by its position within language, not by its status as a concept that happens to be linguistic.

Cepstral coefficients are computed to serve speech recognition and audio processing. Remove speech-processing as a domain and cepstral-coefficients have no operational application — they are meaningless as features without the speech-processing context that gives them their purpose and meaning. The removal test passes.

The cepstrum as a quefrency-domain CONCEPT was derived from signal-processing practice. Bogert, Healy and Tukey invented cepstral analysis specifically to address signal-processing needs (detecting periodic structures in spectra for speech analysis). The concept of quefrency-domain representation was derived from and named after the signal-processing operations (FFT, log, IFFT) that produce it. Which-came-first: signal-processing methods and needs existed first; the cepstrum concept was derived from them.

MFCCs are computed by applying the Discrete Cosine Transform to the logarithm of the mel-frequency spectrogram values. The mel-frequency spectrogram is the direct input data structure for MFCC computation — removing it eliminates the feature representation from which MFCCs are derived. The dependency is structural and constitutive.

CONTAINS = part-of: stress is a dimension within the prosodic framework, not a framework in its own right. Prosody's accepted definition names stress as one of the patterns it analyzes ('rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns'); stress is a parameter of the framework — a prominence-marking dimension with its own cue bundle — not a self-contained system. Contrast meter, which is a self-contained prosodic system and stands as INSTANCE_OF. Sense pinned (Law 11d): stress as the phonological dimension of syllable prominence within the prosodic system.

MFCC computation pipeline: after applying the mel filterbank to the power spectrum, the algorithm computes the logarithm of the filterbank outputs. Removing logarithm as a concept stops the MFCC pipeline at stage 2 — there is no log to compress the filterbank energies before the DCT step. The accepted definition carves this step explicitly: 'computes the logarithm of filter outputs.' Operational dependency per Law 8b.

Cepstrum computation requires log magnitude spectrum, computed via STFT. Remove STFT and the cepstrum has no spectral decomposition mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes. Note: also has DERIVED_FROM pending, but DEPENDS_ON captures the operational dependency.

The syllable is a structural unit within phonology — a hierarchical organization of segments into rhythmic groups. Phonology contains syllable structure as one of its core domains, alongside segments, prosody, and phonotactics.

Spectral analysis structurally requires the power spectrum as its primary analytical object. Spectral analysis decomposes a signal's energy distribution across frequency — this decomposition IS the power spectrum. Remove the power-spectrum concept and spectral analysis has no output representation — it cannot express 'energy at frequency f' without the power spectrum framework.

Parameters: (1) frequency resolution; (2) windowing function. Persistence mechanism: energy computation via FFT magnitude squaring.

Laws: 6, 8b

Pinned sense (Law 11d): lexicography per its accepted definition — the craft of compiling dictionaries, the systematic description and organization of a language's vocabulary into reference works; linguistics per its accepted definition — the discipline of language. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): the discipline's scope comprises its component practices, and the board has already accepted this exact direction for the other branches (linguistics CONTAINS syntax, morphology, phonology, phonetics, semantics, pragmatics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, computational-linguistics, historical-linguistics). Lexicography is the branch that organizes the lexical level into reference works — a component practice of the whole, not the whole. Part, not identity (Law 8c): remove lexicography and the discipline still operates — its other branches continue; the court has already ruled lexicography a kind of linguistics (INSTANCE_OF accepted) and its DEPENDS_ON language edge stands. This completes the accepted subfield pattern: CONTAINS + INSTANCE_OF + DEPENDS_ON.

MFCC computation requires DCT as its final transformation step: after computing the log mel-spectrogram, the Discrete Cosine Transform is applied to decorrelate the mel-filterbank outputs and produce the final cepstral coefficients. Remove the DCT concept and the MFCC pipeline has no mechanism to convert from the correlated mel-filterbank domain to the decorrelated cepstral domain.

Parameters: (1) number of cepstral coefficients — DCT output dimensions; (2) DCT type (typically Type 2). Persistence mechanism: orthogonal transform of the log mel-spectrogram vector.

Laws: 6, 8b

Removal test (Law 8b): speech-intelligibility as a scientific concept depends on speech-processing as the operational mechanism. Remove speech-processing and the scientific framework for intelligibility collapses: no mechanism to measure, no processing stages to model, no neural correlates to investigate. Speech-intelligibility is defined as an outcome of speech-processing; remove the processing mechanism and intelligibility ceases to be a scientific construct.

Chroma features structurally require the power spectrum: chroma (pitch class profiles) are computed by transforming the power spectrum into a harmonic representation, then folding frequencies into 12 pitch classes by summing energy in each class. Remove the power spectrum and chroma has no input.

Linear predictive coding (LPC) is structurally tied to cepstral coefficients: LPCC (Linear Prediction Cepstral Coefficients) are computed directly from LPC parameters. The LPC analysis predicts speech sample values using a linear combination of past samples, and the resulting reflection coefficients are transformed into cepstral coefficients. Remove the cepstral-coefficients concept and LPC loses its primary representational output — the LPC filter coefficients ARE a cepstral representation of the vocal tract.

Parameters: (1) LPC order — number of prediction coefficients; (2) analysis method — Burg, autocorrelation, covariance. Persistence mechanism: solving the Yule-Walker equations for prediction coefficients.

Laws: 6, 8b

Cepstral coefficients are computed by taking the logarithm of the power spectrum. Removing logarithm as a concept stops the computation at step 1 of the algorithm — without logarithm, the power spectrum cannot be converted to log-power spectrum.

Pitch-shifting operates by manipulating the frequency components of audio in the STFT domain — either through phase-vocoder methods that shift spectral frames, or time-domain approaches that first transform to the frequency domain. The STFT provides the core spectral representation from which pitch-shifted audio is reconstructed. Removing the STFT eliminates the computational framework for pitch-shifting.

The cepstrum is computed as IFFT(log(power spectrum)). Remove the power-spectrum concept and the cepstrum has no input to transform — the entire pipeline collapses at step one. The definition's core operation requires power spectrum as its data substrate. This is a present-tense operational dependency (Law 8), distinct from the historical DERIVED_FROM that already records that the power spectrum concept predates the cepstrum.

A mel-frequency spectrogram operates by warping the linear frequency axis onto the mel scale via triangular filter banks, then computing energy in each mel band. Removing the mel-scale concept eliminates the frequency transformation that defines the mel-frequency spectrogram — the technique cannot operate without it. The dependency is structural and constitutive, not merely historical.

STFT is a signal-processing method that partitions signals into time-localized segments and applies Fourier analysis. Remove the signal-processing apparatus and STFT loses its computational environment — no windowing, no segmenting, no spectral estimation infrastructure. Removal test: without signal-processing primitives, STFT cannot operate.

Removal test (Law 8b): neurolinguistics' accepted definition carves its object as language — specifically, the neural and biological mechanisms of language acquisition, processing, representation, and comprehension. Remove language (the structured system of human communication that neurolinguistics studies) and neurolinguistics loses its entire domain: no language to map onto brains, no neural correlates to study, no language disorders to investigate. It stops operating as a discipline. Specific, not the meta-level shadow: language is the carved subject matter named in the definition, not a universal every entry needs. Same structural shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language and linguistics DEPENDS_ON language edges.

Language operates through symbols — signs that stand for something within a conventionally shared system.
